newsitem.title: USA: Country Star Restaurants gets financing.
newsitem.headline: Country Star Restaurants gets financing.

text.p: Country Star Restaurants Inc said it secured $3.5 million in financing through an arrangement with its new chief executive and an institutional investor.

The credit line bears interest at a rate of prime plus four percentage points, payable semiannually starting December 31, said chief executive Dan Rubin, who also holds the title of president. The loan's principal balance is due and payable October 9, 1999, he added.

The unnamed institutional investor exchanged its 4,000 shares of the company's Series B preferred shares for a convertible term note of $4,000,000, said the company, which owns and operates the Country Star American Music Grills.
